reviewDisposition.finding: Injected UI clock and repository clock could give different week anchors.
reviewDisposition.resolution: Added explicit injected-clock regression, observed initial-week assertion fail, then used clock.now() for initial/current week. Focused spec re-review and final checks followed.

reviewDisposition.finding: Midnight test changes both the local day and UTC hour.
reviewDisposition.resolution: Recorded its actual scope; it proves minute-driven midnight refresh, not every time-zone/hour combination. Existing UTC-hour trigger is retained.

reviewDisposition.finding: Hot minute clock replays stale time after deep sleep until the pending delay wakes.
reviewDisposition.resolution: Reproduced with wall-only day jump while lifecycle paused, then added ON_RESUME clock refresh merged into the minute state. Sharing is explicitly eager for existing maintenance.

reviewDisposition.finding: Second-collector lifetime coverage outside the today tab.
reviewDisposition.resolution: Added counting-clock test: exactly one live second collector across today/plan/review with global timer visible, zero in editor and after stop. Rejected suggested zero collectors on plan/review, where the existing global timer remains visible.

reviewDisposition.finding: Duration still uses wall time; backward-jump tick case is untested.
reviewDisposition.resolution: Preserved existing timer semantics instead of introducing a monotonic anchor feature; recorded limits. No backward-jump result claimed.

reviewDisposition.finding: Resume-triggered recurring catch-up is not independently asserted; STARTED can precede ON_RESUME.
reviewDisposition.resolution: Non-blocking review limits recorded. Midnight refresh and resumed date freshness are separately verified. Unfocused STARTED-only visibility can wait for the next minute. No additional lifecycle or product change made.
